cast_speed_formula.user_statement: release speed = base release speed * (1 + increased cast speed)
cast_speed_formula.note: formula shape user-confirmed; exact base release speed could not be precisely tested in this round
cast_speed_formula.model_standing: v2 cast_time = 1 / (animation_speed * speedMultiplier * (1 + increased cast speed)); with as=1.8333375, speedMultiplier=0.8 -> base 1.46667/s (0.6818s), current build +35.2% -> 0.5043s. This matches the stated linear-in-(1+inc) shape.
cast_speed_formula.conclusion: Cast speed formula shape confirmed; base release-speed constant remains from game ability fields and was not independently measured.
